To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the electric power harvesting from the mechanical excitation of the PZT stack is very weakly dependent on the parameters of the electric circuit; 2) The best efficiency of electric power harvesting is achieved for the multilayer PZT stack with large number of layers.

the maximum electric energy can be harvested from the multilayer PZT stack by using the passive circuit with the large electric load resistance and small electric load capacitance, which are in the range of the order of 100 kOhm and 1 nF, respectively.

the passive electric load of the multilayers piezoelectric energy harvesters, which is based on the full bridge rectifier with the filtering circuitry, is not sensitive on the circuit parameters, and the best efficiency is achieved for the largest possible number of PZT layers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the optimal electric power harvesting circuitry for a multilayered stack transducer.
the optimization of the electric power harvesting from the multilayer piezoelectric stacks, which is based on the FE investigation and the proposed simplified lumped model.
the optimization of the electric power harvesting system, using the PZT stack as a power source.
